answer: Only proven work may dock at the wharf: every finished job enters a public manifest, each stamped with a lotus seal from its client. A bid above ten units needs seven sealed entries from four clients in a month; two sparrow couriers show it to one client at random, who must confirm an entry within a day. A forged seal, one entry on two bids, or a silent client forfeits the 35-unit fee per entry; 100 fakes need 700 entries and risk 24,500 units.
